room.name: Room name
room.deleteNotice: Devices will move to Unassigned. Device access will remain unchanged.
device.name: Device name
error.ROOM_NOT_FOUND: This room is no longer available. Refresh the room list.
error.ROOM_NAME_CONFLICT: A room already uses this name.
error.REQUEST_RETIRED: This request was already recorded. Its receipt expired; refresh state before considering another write.
execution.historyEmpty: No retained operations for this device.
error.SECRET_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Configure the system credential store.
error.SECRET_STORE_LOCKED: Unlock the system credential store before trying again.
error.SECRET_STORE_CONFLICT: Multiple entries match this credential reference. Resolve the conflict before continuing.
error.SECRET_STORE_WRITE_UNKNOWN: The credential change may have completed. Check its status before trying again.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.scopeNotice: Local counts and recent outcome summaries. No live connection checks.
diagnostics.privacyNotice: Identifiers, names, state values, arguments, and raw messages are omitted. Review the report before sharing.
diagnostics.historyNotice: Includes at most {count} stored receipts. Composite operations may appear more than once.
error.INVALID_OBSERVATION: The state data is inconsistent. Refresh to obtain a valid observation.
error.DEVICE_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: The discovered connection conflicts with this saved device. Its existing identity has been preserved.
error.REQUEST_NOT_FOUND: No receipt was found in this profile. This does not establish whether the device acted; do not automatically resend.
error.AUTH_REQUIRED: Reconnect this platform account to continue.
error.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This local account is no longer available. Reload the account list.
error.ACCOUNT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: This is a different platform account. Reconnect the original account to keep its device bindings.
error.ACCOUNT_SESSION_UNCONFIRMED: Saved authorization needs recovery. Open this platform account to recover it.
error.MIDEA_RESPONSE_INVALID: The platform returned an unsupported response.
error.MIDEA_REQUEST_FAILED: The platform data could not be retrieved.
error.MIDEA_INVENTORY_PARTIAL: Some platform devices could not be retrieved. Existing device cards were kept.
error.AUTH_FLOW_UNSUPPORTED: Account connection is not available in this host.
error.MIDEA_LOGIN_INPUT_UNSUPPORTED: This account or password format is not supported by the current connection method.
account.connectedRetrievalFailed: Account connection succeeded, but devices could not be loaded.
error.ACCOUNT_REMOVAL_PENDING: Complete local cleanup before connecting this platform account again.
error.ACCOUNT_SCOPE_CHANGED: The linked devices changed. Review the removal scope again.
error.ACCOUNT_REMOVAL_UNSUPPORTED: A linked device has other connections. This account cannot be removed safely yet.
account.removal.confirm: Remove this account and {count} linked device cards from this installation? Rooms and operation receipts will remain. Other installations and the platform account are unaffected.
account.removal.pending: Local cleanup is incomplete. This local account is disabled.
account.removal.removed: The account was removed from this installation. Platform authorization elsewhere was not revoked.
cleanup.cache.confirm: Clear cached device state from this installation? Accounts, rooms and operation receipts will remain. Active reads may save new snapshots.
cleanup.history.confirm: Clear detailed operation history, including uncertain outcomes? Request IDs will remain reserved to prevent replay. Devices and cached state will remain.
cleanup.history.busy: An operation is still being recorded. Wait for it to finish, then retry clearing history.
account.recovery.confirm: Use this account’s saved authorization to recover access and reload devices? Existing rooms and device names will be kept.
account.recovery.complete: Saved authorization recovered and devices loaded.
account.recovery.pending: Recovery is incomplete. Existing local account data has been kept.
account.recovery.retrievalFailed: The account is stored, but devices could not be loaded. Review the retrieval error.
account.recovery.unrecoverable: Saved account data is missing or damaged. Recovery and sign-in cannot safely restore its device bindings. Removing and reconnecting is a separate action that loses its saved organization.
account.recovery.expired: Saved authorization has expired. Sign in to the original account to retain existing device organization when its saved account data is intact.
account.reauthorization.action: Sign in to the original account
account.reauthorization.confirm: Sign in again to this platform account? Existing rooms and device names will be kept only if the saved account identity matches. Device control permissions will stay the same.
error.MIDEA_DEVICE_NOT_LISTED: This device was missing from the last complete platform list. Refresh the account before trying again.
error.MIDEA_INVENTORY_REQUIRED: Refresh this platform account to confirm its device list before reading or controlling devices.
error.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The confirmation expired. Review the command again before confirming.
error.APPROVAL_INVALID: The device or confirmation context changed. Review the command again.
